_about: Items whose attack effects illusions still don't apply, per patch: Valve's notes say only 'excluding Skull Basher and a few other items' (7.42). Found in the game's code: every item modifier's attack handler that returns when the attacker is an illusion (m_bIsIllusion), compared with the previous patch. Static analysis of copies of server.dll, not checked in a match.

items: Witch Blade's poison (Magic Corruption does apply)
